objective: Reduce repeated run-record and model-trace disk I/O during long inference without changing JSON meaning or atomic commit behavior.

benchmark_protocol.source: read-only copy of the formal last_run.json decoded once
benchmark_protocol.writes: temporary file followed by atomic replace in a temporary directory
benchmark_protocol.scaled_payload: 16 copies of the decoded formal record inside a synthetic container

implementation.last_run: compact UTF-8 JSON through the existing bounded fast/streaming writer
implementation.model_debug: compact UTF-8 JSON through the same writer
implementation.candidate_clear_debug_rewrite: compact UTF-8 JSON through the same writer

limitations: The measured latency is local atomic JSON write time, not full GPU inference latency.
Formal runtime records were intentionally left byte-identical during deployment acceptance; compact serialization will apply on the next legitimate run/debug write.
Model outputs, candidate identity, human truth and training-return policy are unchanged.
